Also on a project or campaign
Cultural DNA: a versioned cultural profile built from completed discoveries.
Market Expansion: the Atlas pipeline per market, compared on the same evidence.
Trend Watch: compares two saved discovery snapshots without a model call.
Campaign Arena: 2 to 4 variants with the same segments, dimensions, and criteria.
Risk Radar: findings keep observation and interpretation apart; applying one creates a user-edit adaptation.
Evidence Graph: every persisted link between these records.
